title: A Systematic Analysis of Base Model Choice for Reward Modeling
authors_zh: Kian Ahrabian，Pegah Jandaghi，Negar Mokhberian，Sai Praneeth Karimireddy，Jay Pujara。
paper_type_zh: 奖励模型基座选择与可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 训练、筛选或审计偏好奖励模型的研究者。
one_line: Accepted analysis of base-model choices as a reward-model reliability variable.
系统证明 RM 基座选择与训练阶段会显著改变 RewardBench 表现，并给出低维筛选线索。
why: It adds a concrete reliability or failure-mode evaluation surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reward-model work often treats the base LLM as a default, although leaderboard outcomes may be driven by that hidden choice. This confounds claims about data or objective quality.

The paper holds RM training fixed while varying base model and training stage, then tests which public capabilities predict downstream RM quality. It is an empirical selection audit, not a new RM dataset.

奖励模型工作常把基座 LLM 当默认项，榜单结果却可能主要由这一隐藏选择驱动；这会混淆训练数据或目标函数真正带来的质量贡献，也令跨论文的 RM 可靠性比较缺乏可比基础。

论文固定 RM 训练、替换基座与训练阶段，并检验公开能力指标能否预测下游 RM 质量。它是经验性选择审计，不是提出新奖励模型数据集或架构。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The object is base-model selection for reward modeling: 40 chat models receive the same RM recipe, size-matched alternatives are compared with Llama-3.x, and sparse public capability signals are combined for selection. The analysis also separates SFT, later alignment and estimated pre-training composition. No new official downloadable dataset is claimed; it uses HelpSteer2-Preference and a 1M-document SlimPajama analysis sample.
核心对象是 RM 基座选择：作者令 40 个 chat model 使用同一奖励训练配方，在同尺寸组内与 Llama-3.x 比较，并以稀疏公开能力信号做选择；同时分离 SFT、后续对齐和估计预训练组成。论文未称开放新数据集；使用 HelpSteer2-Preference，并从 SlimPajama 五类语料各抽 20 万文档，构成 100 万条分析样本。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Size-band 40 chat bases, train each for one epoch on HelpSteer2-Preference with a scalar head, and select the checkpoint by validation accuracy.
  2. Evaluate binary-preference and multi-attribute regression RMs on RewardBench’s about 3k tasks/23 datasets.
  3. Correlate RM score with 33 public benchmarks and scale metrics; fit Elastic Net with 10-fold CV, accepting a selector by held-out top-k coverage.
  4. Compare Llama-3.1-8B post-training checkpoints, then estimate document-presence scores on 1M SlimPajama samples. The paper reports about 4,500 GPU-hours; model versions and compute details must be fixed for reproduction.

1. 将 40 个 chat 基座按参数量分组，以 HelpSteer2-Preference 训练一轮并接标量奖励头，依验证准确率选 checkpoint。
  2. 在 RewardBench 约 3,000 题、23 数据集上评估二元偏好与多属性回归 RM，输出四类和均值准确率。
  3. 将 RM 分数与 33 个公开基准及规模指标相关，以 10 折交叉验证 Elastic Net 预测；只有留出 top-k 覆盖率决定筛选是否接受。
  4. 对比 Llama-3.1-8B 后训练 checkpoint，并在 100 万 SlimPajama 样本上估计文档存在分数。论文报告约 4,500 GPU 小时；复现须固定模型版本、算力和评测版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The main controlled comparison fixes HelpSteer2-Preference RM training, size-bands 40 bases, and evaluates on RewardBench. Qwen2.5 and Gemma-2 exceed a size-matched Llama-3.x by up to about 14% (Fig. 2). In public Llama-3.1-8B checkpoints, Tulu-3 SFT scores 84.2 versus base 72.9 (+15.5% relative; Table 1), while later DPO/RLVR lowers it to 81.6/80.2. This supports recipe-conditional selection, not a universal model ranking.

主对照固定 HelpSteer2-Preference 的 RM 训练，将 40 个基座按尺寸分组并在 RewardBench 评估。Qwen2.5、Gemma-2 相比同尺寸 Llama-3.x 最高约提升 14%（图 2）。公开 Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint 中，Tulu-3 SFT 为 84.2，base 为 72.9（相对 +15.5%，表 1），后续 DPO/RLVR 降至 81.6/80.2。它支持配方条件下的选择，不是普适模型排名。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Common practice fixes a popular base, often Llama-3.x, then compares RM recipes. This paper makes base identity the controlled variable, measures top-k coverage rather than correlation alone, and separates training-stage effects. Its novelty is the audit of variables that can alter RM conclusions, not a new preference loss or regressor.
常见做法先固定一个流行基座（多为 Llama-3.x）再比较 RM 配方。本文把基座身份作为受控变量，以 top-k 覆盖率而非仅相关性衡量选择，并分离训练阶段效应。新意是审计会改写 RM 结论的选择变量，而不是提出新的偏好损失或回归器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. The fixed small training dataset may hide behaviors from larger RM corpora; the reported experiment cost is about 4,500 GPU-hours.
  2. The post-SFT decline is observed on only limited public checkpoints, so its cause is unresolved.
  3. Pre-training composition uses an inferred presence score on a subset, not verified provenance; reuse must not treat it as a clean training-data label.

1. 固定的小训练集可能掩盖大规模 RM 语料下的行为；作者报告实验约需 4,500 GPU 小时。
  2. SFT 后性能下降只在有限公开 checkpoint 中观察到，原因尚未确定。
  3. 预训练组成来自子集上的推断存在分数，并非已核验的数据溯源；复用时不可把它当作干净训练数据标签。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this before committing to an RM base: train a fixed pilot recipe on size-matched candidate bases, report RewardBench categories and top-k selection coverage, then retain a base only if gains persist under the same data and budget. It is unsuitable as a shortcut for tasks whose reward data, deployment language, or verifier differs from the paper’s setting.
在确定 RM 基座前，可在同尺寸候选上训练固定小型配方，报告 RewardBench 各类准确率及 top-k 选择覆盖率；只有在相同数据和预算下收益仍存在才保留该基座。若奖励数据、部署语言或 verifier 与论文设置不同，不能把本文结论当作免实验的选择捷径。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Base model is an RM reliability variable, not bookkeeping.
  2. The controlled recipe is one epoch of HelpSteer2-Preference training.
  3. No new official dataset is released; 1M SlimPajama samples serve analysis.
  4. Evidence anchor: up to 14% over size-matched Llama-3.x; SFT 84.2 vs 72.9.
  5. Reuse decision: pilot multiple bases; do not infer provenance from presence scores.

1. 定位：基座并非记账项，而是 RM 可靠性变量。
  2. 抓手：固定 HelpSteer2-Preference 训练一轮，再替换基座。
  3. Artifact：未开放新数据；100 万 SlimPajama 样本仅用于分析。
  4. 证据：同尺寸最高约胜 Llama-3.x 14%，SFT 为 84.2 对 72.9。
  5. 决定：先试多个基座；不可由存在分数推断训练语料溯源。
